title: world
description: A nucleus (object of the ambient relational category R, carrying quasicrystalline structure and an internal flow) that is a self-contained universe-like region: internally connected (W1), equipped with a time-like endomorphism (W2), and non-degenerate everywhere (W3). The root of astronomy: our universe is one world, and the world-bearing relational substrate contains all worlds. The ambient relational topos R is upstream (the corpus's relating substrate).

connected.description: (W1) internally connected under its flow — not a disconnected plurality

time-endomorphism.description: (W2) a designated T_W : W → W acting dynamically on its states — a notion of 'when'

non-degenerate.description: (W3) its quasicrystalline structure has no global degenerations — it is not itself a hole or pool
